description.value: Socrates Grill is a family-owned Greek-style restaurant that has anchored the Maple Ridge community since 1993, specializing in flame-broiled dishes including chicken souvlaki, wild sockeye salmon, and New Zealand lamb chops. The restaurant offers both sit-down dining with reservations and a takeout menu, positioned along Lougheed Highway as a potential resupply stop for cyclists passing through the area. Customer reviews consistently highlight a relaxed atmosphere and quality food.

address.value: 20691 Lougheed Highway #19, Maple Ridge, BC V2X 2P9
